text: Acadomia is the tutoring brand of AIS 2 SAS - ACADOMIA, a subsidiary of DOMIA GROUP SA (RCS Nice 483 820 080). Metric Capital Partners lists Acadomia (Domia Group) in its portfolio, invested by its Fund I since 2013 with status Exited.
short: Acadomia is a brand of Domia Group; Metric Capital Partners' Fund I held the company (exited).
